nodes.label: 10X-20X Market Finder Prompt (Monster Market)
nodes.rationale: Live Reddit research in 4 phases: find threads (engagement = market size), identify the biggest demographic+problem combo, extract the avatar profile in their exact words with source links, rank by market size and Eugene Schwartz sophistication with a TAM estimate. Future: research agent runs Phase 1 with Apify / reddit-mcp tools.

nodes.label: Eugene Schwartz Market Sophistication Levels
nodes.rationale: 5-level awareness scale used to rank every avatar/angle: 1 Unaware, 2 Problem Aware, 3 Solution Aware, 4 Product Aware, 5 Most Aware - determines how the campaign must open and what it must prove.
